headline: On last trading day, Sensex jumped nearly 900 points and Nifty reclaimed 22,500 led by a rally in IT.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Tuesday, 13 October.

why: IT sector stocks like TCS witnessed a sharp rally, with the sectoral index gaining 3%
The FMCG sector provided strong support, gaining over 2% during the last trading session
Broad-based buying was seen as all sectoral indices ended in the green on Friday
The market recovered from an 8-week losing streak, driven by positive domestic buying
whatHappening: Sensex surged nearly 900 points while Nifty settled above 22,500 in the last session
E-commerce platforms reported robust festive sales of Rs 24,000 crore in just two days
India's nuclear sector is poised for a boost with a projected Rs 7.5 lakh crore private investment
IndiGo reported a smoke alert on a Delhi-Chennai flight, which safely diverted to Hyderabad
summary: The Indian stock market saw a strong recovery in the last session, with the Sensex gaining nearly 900 points. This rally, which ended an eight-week losing streak, was primarily driven by significant gains in the IT and FMCG sectors. Markets are currently closed for the weekend and are scheduled to reopen this coming Tuesday.
